Hello! 😉

I'm Wenyu Liu (<img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/wenyu.svg" alt="wenyu Logo"/> <img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/liu.svg" alt="liu Logo" style="margin-right: 0em"/>), a master student in energy at <img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/epfl-logo.svg" alt="EPFL Logo" style="height: 0.9em"/> École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL). 

Currently, I am living in <img class="inline-svg" src="./files/CHE_Saint-Sulpice_VD_COA.svg" alt="Saint-Sulpice VD COA"> St-Sulpice, Switzerland.

Before 2023, I lived in Xi'an, China, where I completed my bachelor's degree in energy storage at <img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/xjtu-logo.svg" alt="XJTU Logo"/>  Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU).

I speak Chinese, English and a little French. &ensp; 我说汉语，英语和一点法语。&ensp;Je parle anglais, chinois et un peu français.
